description:
`jit gate update` refuses when another agent leases an issue that requires the gate, as `jit gate remove` does.

## Background

17fbcf25 gave one lease rule to every command, and `gate remove` now refuses under another agent's lease because it changes what a leased issue requires. `gate update` can change what a leased issue's required gate checks and has no check, so the two differ.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `jit gate update` on a gate required by an issue another agent leases refuses in strict mode, and warns in warn mode, through `refuse_foreign_leases`.
- [hard] REQ-02: The table-driven lease test carries `gate update` as a refusal row.
title: Lease-check gate update
